summary: MercadoLibre filed a Form 8-K reporting the September 14, 2026 closing of its underwritten public offering of $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 5.850% notes due 2036. The notes were issued under an existing 2021 indenture, as supplemented by a fifth supplemental indenture, and are guaranteed by several operating subsidiaries. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown off an effective shelf registration statement, not a special situation; proceeds are not earmarked in the excerpt. Watch for use-of-proceeds disclosure, leverage and interest-coverage trends, and any rating actions.
